conviction_note: Q3 is not pre-released (no vinstvarning or other inside-information release since the 2026-08-17 Q2 report), so the numbers are new on a one-analyst name whose observed report-day moves have a median near 7% (abs_move 7.5). The lean is mildly positive: the sole estimate (revenue 632 MSEK, +7.0% y/y) sits inside the Q2 run rate the CEO said had not changed drastically into mid-August, the closest peer printed organic +8%/+12% in Aug/Sep, there is a margin lever against an easy Q3 2025 base, and three board members bought shares after the Q2 report. Against that, Q3 2025 operating cash flow of 103 MSEK came from a working-capital release that a pre-Q4 inventory build will not repeat, autumn ERP-preparation costs were flagged, and the stock is up about 10% since 2026-10-06 and 23% over 60 days, so a confirming print is partly priced. p_up 54 gives +0.6 scaled; the findings sum to +0.8, the same sign at a similar size.

already_public.what: Q2 2026 report: net sales +8.4% to 574.3 MSEK, comparable +7.1%, gross margin 43.3%, adj. EBITA 5.1 MSEK; no numeric guidance, only financial targets (growth >5%, adj. EBITA margin 6-8%)
CEO to Nyhetsbyrån Direkt: no drastic change in trading vs Q2 so far in Q3; growth in Q4 remains the target; own-brand stock arriving by ship 'within a month'
Board share purchases after Q2: Westerberg 200,000 (Aug 18-19) + 200,000 (Aug 24 at 15.00), Zaudy 172,749 (Aug 21 at 14.50), Ljungerud 25,006 (Sep 9-10 at 15.20-15.50)
Report date and time confirmed: Q3 interim report 22 October 2026 at 07:00 CEST, webcast 10:00

new_in_release.expect: Q3 net sales around 635-645 MSEK against the single estimate of 632 (Q3 2025: 590.9). Q2's +8.4% run rate, a stronger NOK on the ~20% Norwegian share and the easy Danish comparison point slightly above the bar.

Gross margin around 43-44% against an adjusted 41.6% in Q3 2025 (29.1% reported, after a 74.2 MSEK inventory write-down). Adj. EBITA likely above Q3 2025's 16.7 MSEK, with an offset from the cost base the company calls too high and from autumn ERP preparation. Up, with uncertainty.
Operating cash flow well below Q3 2025's 103.2 MSEK, which came from a working-capital release while the company was short of cash; Q3 2026 should show the pre-Q4 inventory build. Down.
Unknown. Commentary on October trading and Q4 preparation (inventory availability, Black Week) is likely and could set the tone.
No numeric guidance is given; the financial targets will most likely be reiterated, so no guidance event is expected.
None (policy unchanged; no dividend paid in 2024-2026).

bar: Q3 2026 revenue 632 MSEK (+7.0% y/y), one analyst, Yahoo earningsTrend for KJELL.ST (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v10/finance/quoteSummary/KJELL.ST?modules=earningsTrend), read 2026-10-21; no EPS or EBITA estimate for the quarter. This is one estimate, not a company statement or two agreeing sources, so every finding is capped small.

findings.finding: Gross-margin lever on an easy base: H1 2026 gross margin was 44.0% (Q2 43.3%) against an adjusted 41.6% in Q3 2025, which the company and Affärsvärlden both call structural (renegotiated purchasing, more own brands, new warehouse). At ~635 MSEK of sales, 1.5-2.5pp of margin is 10-15 MSEK of gross profit against Q3 2025 adj. EBITA of 16.7 MSEK, and the market has no quarterly profit estimate to anchor on.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 (adj. EBITA 5.1 vs -9.2, GM +1.1pp): +6.72% on the day, +12% intraday. Q1 2026 (GM up but EBITA margin -2.7% on a 13% sales drop): -6.76%.
findings.original_quote: Marginalförbättringen bedöms enligt bolaget vara av strukturell karaktär, till följd av de förändringar som genomförts samt en högre andel egna varumärken. (Affärsvärlden via Placera, 2026-08-12: the company considers the margin improvement structural, due to the changes made and a higher share of own brands.)
findings.why_not_priced: The only sell-side number in the market is a revenue estimate, so there is no published quarterly EBITA bar. If the margin path were priced, an EBITA estimate would sit visibly above 16.7 MSEK; instead the one public model (Affärsvärlden, 2026-08-12) has 2026 sales flat, below the current run rate. The 60-day run-up (+23%) suggests investors expect improvement in general but have not been given a number.
findings.independence: Affärsvärlden's analysis (https://placera.se/analys/kjell-group-med-okad-risk-for-bakslag-2026-08-12) forecasts a 43-44% gross margin; it rests on the same company statements, so it is only partly independent.

findings.finding: Closest listed peer Clas Ohlson (same Swedish/Norwegian accessory and household-electronics shopper) reported organic sales growth of +8% in August and +12% in September 2026, with a stronger NOK adding to reported growth. That points to a healthy Q3 demand backdrop in both of Kjell's store markets.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Sales growth is the line that moved Kjell: return to +8.4% growth in Q2 2026 gave +6.72%; the -13% sales drop in Q1 2026 gave -6.76%.
findings.original_quote: Hemfixarkedjan Clas Ohlsons försäljning i september uppgick till 1 119 miljoner kronor (939), en ökning med 19 procent, varav 12 procent avser organisk tillväxt, 3 procent förvärv och 5 procent valutaeffekter. (Clas Ohlson's September sales were 1,119 MSEK (939), up 19%, of which 12% organic, 3% acquisitions and 5% currency.)
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: Kjell has risen from 15.4 SEK on 2026-10-06 to about 17.0, roughly 10%, since the peer's September print, which is what a read-through being priced looks like. It is a proxy, and Clas Ohlson has outgrown Kjell for years, so transmission to Kjell is a hypothesis. It stays small.
findings.independence: Clas Ohlson August organic +8% (https://www.placera.se/telegram/clas-ohlson-organisk-forsaljning-8-i-augusti-20260903). Same company, but a different month.

findings.finding: On 2026-08-17 the CEO said Q3 trading so far showed no drastic change from Q2's +7.1% comparable growth. The single revenue estimate (632 MSEK, +7.0%) assumes exactly that, so the bar sits inside what management signalled, with the NOK and the easy Danish comparison (AV-Cables back to growth in June) as small upside.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 (first growth quarter after a long decline): +6.72%.
findings.original_quote: Sandra Gadd vill inte säga om Kjell Group förväntar sig att visa tillväxt även under tredje kvartalet, men uppger att inga drastiska förändringar har setts hittills jämfört med andra kvartalet. (Sandra Gadd will not say whether Kjell Group expects to show growth in Q3 too, but says no drastic changes have been seen so far compared with the second quarter.)
findings.why_not_priced: Public since 2026-08-17 and visible in the estimate, which equals the Q2 run rate. It is close to priced and is sized near zero; the remaining value is the currency and Danish-comparison tailwind the estimate may not include.
findings.independence: Q2 report's own Norway figures (+15.1% local, +21.8% in SEK) show the NOK translation effect is real (https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=b56b7d013734c0584e48f8115af23e5c7&lang=en&src=listed).

findings.finding: Three board members bought shares after the Q2 report, the last of them (Ebba Ljungerud, 25,006 shares at 15.20-15.50 on 9-10 September) about ten weeks into the quarter and just before the 30-day closed period. Chairman Westerberg added 400,000 shares in late August.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The chairman's July 2026 buying (~890,000 shares at 13.9-14.2) preceded the +6.72% reaction to Q2.
findings.original_quote: 2026-09-11 | Kjell Group AB (publ) | Ebba Ljungerud | Styrelseledamot | Förvärv | Aktie | 2026-09-10 | 22 000 | Antal | 15,50 | SEK (FI insider register: board member Ebba Ljungerud, acquisition, 22,000 shares at SEK 15.50 on 2026-09-10)
findings.why_not_priced: Public in FI's register since mid-September and the amounts are small (Ljungerud about SEK 0.4m), so the signal is weak and partly in the price. Its value is timing: a board member buying with July and August trading known is not consistent with a quarter going wrong.

findings.finding: The cost side works against the margin: the CEO called the Q2 cost base too high, Q2 operating expenses rose 4.5% y/y, and the company said autumn would bring more labour-intensive preparation for an ERP upgrade in H1 2027. This partly offsets the gross-margin gain.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026, where costs plus lower sales cut the EBITA margin to -2.7% despite a higher gross margin: -6.76%.
findings.why_not_priced: Stated in the Q2 report, but the size is unknown and the ERP preparation cost has never been quantified. A market that had priced it would carry a profit estimate below the gross-margin arithmetic; no profit estimate exists.

findings.finding: Q3 2025 operating cash flow of +103.2 MSEK came from a working-capital release (working capital fell from 193.8 to 59.8 MSEK while the company was cutting purchases). Q3 2026 should show the opposite as own-brand stock arrives ahead of Q4, so the cash-flow line will likely compare badly year on year, with net debt/EBITDAaL already 3.5x against a target below 2.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 operating cash flow of -28.7 MSEK (vs -136.1) came with +6.72%. Cash has not decided a reaction here so far; balance-sheet stress did in 2024-25 (two rights issues).
findings.original_quote: Kjell Group laddar nu inför det viktiga fjärde kvartalet och Sandra Gadd uppger att bolaget har egna produkter som anländer via båt om "någon månad" (Placera/Direkt 2026-08-17: own products arriving by ship 'within a month')
findings.why_not_priced: Nobody publishes a cash-flow estimate for this name. The headline year-on-year cash comparison is mechanical and easy to misread on the day, and the one public model has net debt/EBITA falling, which assumes cash generation.
findings.independence: Quarterly data table in the Q2 report (working capital Q2 25 193.8 to Q3 25 59.8; cash flow Q3 25 103.2), the same document. CEO quote on inbound stock: https://www.placera.se/telegram/kjell-group-spar-lagertillganglighet-fortsatter-battras-i-ar-vd-20260817

outside_window.finding: Q4 2026 (Black Week and Christmas) is the quarter the company itself calls decisive, with a 761 MSEK (+9.2%) estimate. Its outcome lands with the year-end report on 2027-02-11; only October commentary can reach this window.
First phase of the ERP upgrade planned for H1 2027: execution risk lies outside the window.

baseline_tension: The findings lean mildly positive, in line with the +3.7% 20-day and +23% 60-day run-up rather than against it. Most of that is already in the price (about +10% since the peer's 2026-10-07 print), so p_up stays close to 50 even though the fundamental read is a small beat.
language_note: The CEO's mid-August comment that Q3 trading showed no drastic change from Q2 ('inga drastiska förändringar har setts hittills jämfört med andra kvartalet') appeared only in the Swedish Nyhetsbyrån Direkt interview, not in the English release
The Affärsvärlden model (2026E sales 2,379 MSEK flat, adj. EBITA 59 MSEK, gross margin 43-44%) is Swedish-only and was the only public profit model found
The board-member purchases come from FI's Swedish insider register (marknadssok.fi.se); English wires carried only the chairman's July buys
Clas Ohlson's monthly sales figures were reached through Swedish Placera/Direkt copy; the company also publishes in English, so this added speed, not new information
lessons_applied: 'Cash can outweigh a raised guide' (Luceco): the working-capital/cash-flow finding goes from -0.5 to -0.8
'A narrow proxy loses' plus the visible run-up since the peer print: the Clas Ohlson read-through goes from +0.8 to +0.5

'A verified fact is not a predicted reaction' plus the run-up into the print: p_up goes from 56 to 54; abs_move_pct stays at 7.5 because the numbers are new and the name's observed report-day median is about 7%
